_comment: ColdStack v5.3.21 Sui asset registry. Extendable: add a full coin type under 'coins' to pin its symbol/decimals (overrides on-chain suix_getCoinMetadata). 'price_as' maps a Sui token symbol to a PriceEngine-known symbol (e.g. LBTC -> BTC). This JSON is the manual 'manage tokens' path for Sui. Any held coin is auto-detected via suix_getAllBalances even without an entry here.
